title: Transport of local finite presentations through the coefficient encoding
statement: For a finite discrete ring B and the encoding of [def-weil-pbc-common-finite-discrete-encoding], let j:U→T and let M be an internal module whose restriction along j is locally finitely presented. There is a pro-etale cover C of U such that each ordinary restriction of E_T.inverse M is a cokernel of a morphism between constant sheaves of finite ULift B-modules.

source.place: Proposition 5.3.2 and Lemmas 5.4.1 and 5.4.3; Stacks Project Tag 09AK

proof.text: Normalize the stratum pullback and the cover pullbacks by restriction of scalars along their invertible coefficient maps; local finite presentations are unchanged by these scalar equivalences.

Use the sectionwise encoding and the sheafification adjunction to identify the regular internal constant-ring module with the constant sheaf of G applied to the regular module in abelian groups. The forgetful equality hG proves its carrier is finite. Equivalences and constant sheafification preserve finite biproducts and cokernels, hence encode every finite presentation.
Apply inverse-image compatibility twice, along j and each cover map, and compose the resulting isomorphisms with the encoded finite-presentation cokernel isomorphism.

theorem finiteDiscreteCoefficient_encoded_presentation [DiscreteTopology B] [Finite B]
    (T U : Scheme.{u}) (j : U ⟶ T) (M : FiniteDiscreteInternalModules B T)
    (hM : IsLocallyFinitelyPresented
      ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} j).obj
        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} B) T))
      (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} j).mapMod
        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} B) T)).obj M)) :
    ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage U, ∀ i : C.I₀,
      ∃ P Q : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} B), Finite P ∧ Finite Q ∧
        ∃ f : (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology (C.X i))
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} B))).obj P ⟶
          (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology (C.X i))
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} B))).obj Q,
          Nonempty (((C.f i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} B)]).obj
            (((j)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} B)]).obj
              ((finiteDiscreteCoefficientEquivalence B eR G hG T).inverse.obj M)) ≅
            cokernel f)
